en.title: Vicon Captures Emotion: Acquires Facial Capture Innovator Captive Devices
en.summary: In a move set to redefine digital performance, motion capture giant Vicon has acquired facial capture specialist Captive Devices. This integration promises to unlock unprecedented levels of nuance in virtual characters.
en.body:
The world of digital character creation just got a major upgrade. **Vicon**, a titan in motion capture technology and the motion capture arm of **Oxford Metrics**, has officially acquired **Captive Devices Ltd**, a UK-based firm renowned for its cutting-edge head-mounted camera systems for markerless facial performance capture. This strategic move integrates **Captive Devices'** high-resolution facial tracking technology directly into **Vicon's** comprehensive motion capture solutions, promising a more seamless and powerful pipeline for filmmakers and game developers alike.

The acquisition sees the founding team of **Captive Devices** join **Vicon**, bringing their specialized expertise and innovative technology to an already formidable platform. For years, **Captive Devices** has been a key player in developing tools that capture every subtle twitch and expression, essential for bringing digital characters to life with believable emotion. Their systems, which integrate directly with powerful engines like **Unreal Engine**, have been lauded for their ability to deliver pristine data, ensuring that the nuances of a performer's face are translated with remarkable fidelity.

## Elevating Digital Performance

This isn't just about acquiring new hardware; it's about merging distinct capabilities. **Vicon** has long been a leader in capturing full-body motion, utilizing both marker-based and markerless systems. The addition of **Captive Devices'** specialized facial capture technology means **Vicon** can now offer an end-to-end performance capture solution that encompasses the entire human form with unparalleled detail. This integration is particularly exciting for **virtual production**, where real-time facial performance is crucial for guiding digital actors and creating immersive virtual environments. Studios like **Ninja Theory**, **Nant Studios**, and **Deep Silver Dambuster Studios** are already leveraging **Captive Devices'** tech, highlighting its industry-proven capabilities.

> "We're talking the highest-res head mounted cameras (Captive Devices) to capture every subtle facial expression. And this is the big one. A full, real-time pipeline that feeds directly into Unreal Engine. Now that is a total game changer." — Captive Devices (paraphrased from source material)

## What This Means for Fans

For us, the viewers and players, this acquisition translates directly into more believable and emotionally resonant digital characters. Imagine the subtle heartbreak of a protagonist conveyed through the finest facial micro-expressions, or the menacing grin of a villain rendered with chilling accuracy. This enhanced performance capture technology means that the digital avatars we see on screen and in games will feel more human, more alive, and capable of expressing a wider spectrum of emotions. The push towards real-time pipelines feeding directly into engines like **Unreal Engine** signals a future where the gap between performance and final render is virtually non-existent, leading to more immersive and impactful storytelling across film and gaming.

## What's Next

While the financial details of the transaction, valued at up to £750,000, have been disclosed, the full integration roadmap and the specific new product offerings from **Vicon** are still unfolding. We can anticipate seeing **Vicon's** enhanced facial capture solutions rolled out progressively, further solidifying their position as a leader in the performance capture industry.
